records.source_statement: If the Moon or ascendant lord bodily applies to the planet denoting recovery, Lilly claims the stolen item will THEN be recovered; separate retrograde/direct application qualifiers address how soon.
preconditions: One of Moon or first-house lord applies bodily to the identified recovery planet, original printed p357.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: The printed consequent explicitly predicts return, not timing alone; the retrograde/direct alternatives remain separate next records. No observed recovery is established.
records.original_anchor: the thing stole shall then be recovered

records.source_statement: Under 'Where the Knave is', the author uses plural 'the Significators' passing from one zodiac sign into another as one alternative assertion of changing lodgings; which/how many must cross is unspecified.
preconditions: Printed PDF397/363: 'if the Significators be going out of one Signe into another' (plural).
exceptions_and_uncertainty: Do not force a singular thief significator or assert ALL/ANY quantification absent from the sentence.

records.source_statement: Under 'He remaines', the ascendant lord is joined to a planet in a cadent house; the original additionally says 'and behold the ascendant', without unambiguously identifying which planetary subject beholds it.
preconditions: First-house lord joined to a planet in a cadent house; a beholding of the ascendant is also mentioned.
exceptions_and_uncertainty: The aspect actor cannot be assigned uniquely to the cadent planet or first lord from the printed grammar. Consequent comes from the section heading, not an explicit following sentence.
